observations.step_label: Request for Evidence response window
observations.quote: 30 days, plus 3 days when mailed under 8 CFR 103.8(b)
observations.notes: Gold activity A20, 8 CFR 335.7. Applicant's response deadline once USCIS continues a case with a written RFE.

observations.step_label: Re-examination scheduling window after failed initial test
observations.quote: not earlier than 60 days, scheduled within the 120-day window
observations.notes: Gold activity A21, 8 CFR 312.5(a) and 8 CFR 335.3(b).

observations.step_label: Decision deadline after initial examination
observations.quote: Decide within 120 days of the initial examination - approve, continue, or deny; miss the mark and applicant may petition the district court.
observations.notes: Gold activity A22, 8 CFR 335.3(a) and 8 U.S.C. S1447(b). Gold notes this is frequently exceeded per user reports and no official distribution of interview-to-decision times is published.

observations.step_label: Written denial deadline after initial interview
observations.quote: Deny in writing no later than 120 days after the initial interview, with a clear statement of the specific reasons
observations.notes: Gold activity A24, INA 335(d); 8 CFR 336.1(a).

observations.step_label: N-336 hearing-request filing deadline after denial
observations.quote: Request a hearing on the denial by filing Form N-336 with the fee within 30 days of the denial
observations.notes: Gold activity A25. Filing deadline only; no published decision time for the N-336 hearing itself (a hole).

observations.step_label: Abandonment window for a missed biometrics/interview appointment
observations.quote: a missed fingerprinting appointment without good cause shown may be treated as abandonment
observations.notes: Gold activity A26, 8 CFR 335.6(a)-(c). Wide range (30 to 365 days) reflects discretion in how long USCIS waits before declaring abandonment.

observations.step_label: Motion-to-reopen response window after a granted application is challenged
observations.quote: Execute a motion to reopen the already-granted application, giving the applicant 15 days to respond
observations.notes: Gold activity A28, 8 CFR 335.5 / 8 CFR 337.10.

observations.step_label: District-court petition trigger if no decision within 120 days
observations.quote: if there is a failure to make a determination under section 1446 of this title before the end of the 120-day period after the date on which the examination is conducted ... the applicant may apply to the district court
observations.notes: INA 336(b) statute text.

observations.step_label: Decision deadline, regulatory citation
observations.quote: A decision to grant or deny the application shall be made at the time of the initial examination or within 120-days after the date of the initial examination
observations.notes: 8 CFR 335.3, reinforcing the same 120-day figure as S5/A22/A24 from the regulation text directly rather than the statute.

observations.step_label: 120-day internal deadline tied to district-court review right
observations.quote: USCIS has 120 days from the date of the initial naturalization interview to issue a decision. If the decision is not issued within 120 days of the interview, an applicant may request judicial review.
observations.notes: Internal SOP/staff-report restatement of the 120-day clock (tiered designed_document per S27's own 'designed' tier field, distinct from the statute/regulation citations above).

observations.step_label: Oath ceremony scheduling hold for derogatory information (no fixed deadline)
observations.quote: USCIS must not schedule an applicant for the administration of the Oath of Allegiance if USCIS receives or identifies disqualifying derogatory information.
observations.notes: USCIS Policy Manual (12 USCIS-PM J.4). No fixed timing rule - only an open-ended, for-cause hold. Value left null since no duration is specified; this documents the ABSENCE of a clock, corroborated by several open-ended reddit cases below (e.g. 1vgfu1a's cancelled/unrescheduled oath).

gold_steps_with_no_duration_evidence: A08 (FBI name check via Enterprise Vetting Center) - 8 CFR 335.2(b) sets a gate, no service level published or reported anywhere in this corpus
A09 (Neighborhood investigation under INA 335(a)) - not published; no reddit mention found
A10 (Applicant submits character reference letters) - no distinct timing evidence; folded into general filing prep
A11 (Officer decides whether to waive neighborhood investigation) - internal discretionary step, no timing evidence
A14 (Officer's pre-interview A-file review) - internal prep step, no distinct timing evidence separate from filing-to-interview span
A16 (Transfer application to new-jurisdiction office if applicant moved) - no timing evidence found

A17 (Interview itself: oath, questioning) - touch-time duration of the interview event not distinctly reported (1vszlqh mentions ~1h20m for one case, folded into notes rather than a separate observation)
A18 (English/civics test administration) - administered within the interview; no separate duration reported
A19 (N-652 results notice issued at end of exam) - same-visit, no distinct timing evidence

A23 (Internal re-verification quality review of approved applications) - not published; one case (1vszlqh) mentions 'submitted for quality review' same-day as approval, but no elapsed duration for the review itself
A27 (Post-approval derogatory-information check before oath) - not published; the S29 for-cause hold documents the RULE but no case in this corpus reports a duration for this specific check
A30/A31 (Oath-ceremony check-in and administration itself) - same-event touch time not reported by any source
A33 (Presumed abandonment after missing more than one oath ceremony) - no timed instance found
A34 (Petition to district court for unreasonable delay) - gold itself notes 'not published; no timed instance in this corpus'
